seoTitle: Add a Favicon in Hostinger Website Builder (2026)
metaDescription: Upload a custom browser tab icon to your Hostinger site through General Settings, giving your site a more professional look.
intro: A favicon is the small icon that appears in a browser tab next to your site's title, and it's an easy way to make your Hostinger site look more polished and recognizable. This guide covers finding the favicon setting and uploading the right image.

steps.heading: Log in to Hostinger
steps.body: Go to hostinger.com, click Login, and enter your account credentials.

steps.heading: Open the website builder
steps.body: From the hPanel dashboard, go to the Home tab, find your website, and click Edit Website to open the builder.

steps.heading: Go to General Settings
steps.body: In the builder, click More Settings, then General Settings, where the favicon upload option lives.

steps.heading: Upload your favicon
steps.body: Click Favicon, then Add Image, and upload a square file — ideally 16x16 or 32x32 pixels — in PNG or ICO format.

steps.heading: Confirm it's live
steps.body: Once uploaded, the favicon goes live automatically, and no coding is required even on Hostinger's free builder.

faq.question: What image size works best for a Hostinger favicon?
faq.answer: A square PNG or ICO file, ideally 16x16 or 32x32 pixels, ensures it displays correctly across devices and browsers.

faq.question: Do I need coding knowledge to add a favicon in Hostinger?
faq.answer: No, the website builder's General Settings menu handles the upload without any code.

faq.question: Where exactly is the favicon setting located?
faq.answer: It's under More Settings, then General Settings, inside the Hostinger website builder.

faq.question: Does this work with Hostinger's free website builder?
faq.answer: Yes, the same process applies whether you're on the free builder or a paid plan.
